summary: Foresight Autonomous Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, announcing its Annual and Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders to be held on July 23, 2026. The filing includes a voting instruction form for holders of American Depositary Shares. Shareholders of record as of July 6, 2026 are entitled to vote. This 6-K is a routine administrative filing and does not relate to any special situation transaction.
